query:
SELECT
                gtm.data_source_id,
                gtm.go_id,
                v.id as version_id,
                v.version_major,
                v.version_minor
            FROM go_term_metadata gtm
            JOIN data_sources ds ON ds.id = gtm.data_source_id
            JOIN versions v ON v.entry_id = ds.id
            WHERE gtm.go_id = ANY($1)
            ORDER BY gtm.go_id, v.version_major DESC, v.version_minor DESC
